title: Q-Reflector: Learning GUI Action Reflection with Generated Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2608.05587v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mobile GUI agents require accurate action reflection for reliable long-horizon execution, assessing whether each action was successfully executed and whether its outcome constitutes a valid step toward the task goal. When evaluated as standalone reflectors under a common prompt, frontier VLMs and specialized GUI models exhibit imbalanced recognition of valid and invalid transitions. We propose Q-Reflector, a standalone reflector based on Qwen3-VL-8B that learns GUI action reflection as supervised structured prediction. Given task context, the executed action, and paired screenshots, it generates pre- and post-conditions specifying the action's prerequisites and intended local effect, then assesses execution success and task validity through a structured rationale and binary verdict. Training combines supervised fine-tuning, teacher-student distillation, and reward- and preference-based refinement. On 1,082 manually verified AndroidWo

translated_title: Q-Reflector：基于生成条件学习的GUI动作反思
translated_abstract: 移动GUI智能体需要准确的动作反思来实现可靠的长期任务执行，即评估每个动作是否被成功执行，以及其结果是否构成向任务目标迈进的有效一步。当在统一提示下作为独立反思器进行评估时，前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）和专门的GUI模型对有效与无效状态转换的识别能力并不均衡。我们提出了Q-Reflector，一个基于Qwen3-VL-8B的独立反思器，它将GUI动作反思学习作为监督式结构化预测任务。给定任务上下文、已执行的动作和成对的前后截图，它会生成前置条件和后置条件，用以明确动作的前提要求及预期的局部效果，然后通过结构化的推理过程和二元判定来评估动作的执行成功与否以及任务有效性。其训练结合了监督微调、师生蒸馏以及基于奖励和偏好的优化改进。在1,082个经人工验证的AndroidWo（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Q-Reflector，一个基于Qwen3-VL-8B的独立GUI动作反思器，通过生成前置/后置条件并以监督微调、蒸馏和奖励偏好优化相结合的训练方式，准确评估移动GUI动作的执行成功性与任务有效性。
en_tdlr: Q-Reflector is a standalone GUI action reflector based on Qwen3-VL-8B that generates pre/post-conditions and combines supervised fine-tuning, distillation, and reward/preference-based refinement to accurately assess action execution success and task validity for mobile GUI agents.
